headline: Moderna Advances Ebola Vaccine Into Human Testing
summary: Moderna Inc. (NASDAQ:MRNA) stock rose in Wednesday premarket trading after gaining 3.4% in the previous session, as investors reacted to the company’s latest progress in expanding its infectious disease pipeline with an investigational Ebola vaccine. headline: Are Wall Street Analysts Predicting Moderna Stock Will Climb or Sink?
summary: Despite Moderna's stellar outperformance over the past year, Wall Street analysts remain cautious about the stock's longer-term prospects.
